item.title: (Seeking Greenlight) Salvation from Ceres
item.description: I made an SCP a few months ago that was deleted. I want to seek advice so I can fix it and resubmit it.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror / Suspense

Page Layout (Optional): Normal, but if someone can tell me how SCP-5999 was made, I might be able to do something like that.

Elevator Pitch: If you look at a picture of Dwarf Planet Ceres, you'll see a mysterious group of lights in the Occator Crater. I created an SCP based on the lights on Ceres.

Central Narrative: Station Tau is an international research base located in the asteroid belt that is dedicated to multiple scientific pursuits, but mainly SCP-XXXX. Station Tau and Ceres were brought to the Foundation's attention after satellites reported after SCP-XXXX, a hot liquid substance was found being ejected from the Occator Crater on Ceres at a high altitude, almost like a volcano erupting. The Foundation then made a deal with officials from Station Tau that the Foundation would cooperate with all of Station Tau's initiatives, and in exchange, Station Tau would allow Foundation Personnel to investigate SCP-XXXX. SCP-XXXX will evaporate any non-planetary material, because of its high temperature. It can hijack all communications systems and broadcast visual and auditory signals that [DATA EXPUNGED] most who hear it. Those who were left unaffected recall seeing an organic lifeform burrowed at the core of Ceres or hearing a female voice speak about its disdain for life. It also creates clones of people who have been near SCP-XXXX (at a safe distance). The moment when SCP-XXXX hijacked Station Tau's communication systems is referred to as Comms Incident One. Shortly after Comms Incident One, a patrol station referred to as Occator-Alpha was placed, and personnel onboard the patrol station were tasked with collecting SCP-XXXX safely so it could be studied. However, when they attempted to extract SCP-XXXX, the station was destroyed and the comms went offline. The maximum height at which SCP-XXXX is being ejected from the surface of Ceres started rising the day Occator-Alpha was destroyed, and has been continually rising at an identical rate since. SCP-XXXX will eventually reach Earth in ██ years. As such, a contingency plan entitled Operation Theta was created in order to ensure the survival of Earth. The main element of the 'story' of SCP-XXXX is the use of the Station Tau Archive Database and Viewing System or STADaVS. It is used by various personnel to access files and either save or delete them.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The danger posed by SCP-XXXX and the element of suspense as you read down the article.

Additional Notes: If you want a draft, I can give the draft.

item.title: Let's Go on an Adventure! (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes
Page Type: SCP Article
Genre: Mystery

Elevator Pitch: A mysterious backpack allows individuals to embark into an anomalous dungeon when they wear it. Each of its six pockets can provide the right tool or object for the immediate situation as they progress, necessary as the dungeon itself is filled with dangerous and undiscovered creatures. Though they don’t realize this gauntlet is more preparing them for what’s to come when they reach the final chamber.

+ More Info
Hide

Central Narrative: Discovered in the Mohave Desert by an excavation team, anyone who wears the backpack and walks through the next doorway disappears into an underground passage that changes structure with every embarkment. There are fifty corridors they must traverse to escape, unable to return through each room’s entrance. Each room may entail puzzles or monsters of unknown origin, and adventurers are advised to use each pocket of their pack sparingly because each one only gets one use per journey.
Once they arrive at the fiftieth and final floor, they come across an ancient underground metropolis that now stands abandoned and derelict. The individuals here were all successful explorers that made their city out of the riches of their exploits, however met a gruesome end when a reality-warping chimera they couldn’t defeat followed them to town. The town was buried in an earthquake, the monster trapped with them, and everyone perished under its distorted claws. This backpack was one of the only pieces of gear left intact after this incident.
On the day someone kills the beast, they will find an exit to the surface, and the backpack will lose all anomalous properties. However, nobody who’s taken the backpack has returned alive. The pack reappears where it was taken with no damage, after the wearer has remained dead for at least two hours.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The backpack desires to bring someone strong enough to take down the powerful beast and avenge the lives of the fallen explorers.

Tags: artifact, adaptive, ectoentropic, interactive, portal, safe, sentient, teleportation

item.title: Ocean's Cell
item.description: Wormhole connecting a family pool to the sea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights:Yes

Page Type:SCP Article

Elevator Pitch:SCP-XXXX is a wormhole of anomalous nature located on a deep-sea level, it has the appearance of a 2 km deep round trench. Any organism or structure that trespasses it fully will shrink down to a 0.001% of its original size. Set hole will unexplainably start to inhale during 2-3 hours specially during June, July and August.

This wormhole is connected to SCP-XXXX-A, (a standard plastic family pool) which is property of a Caucasian family located in ████████████████. After diving 1 km into the pit 1 km, the walls will start to resemble the tube of a filter pump. Once entering SCP-XXXX-A through the filter hole, it appears to have a size of 2000km long, 1500km wide and 1000km high from set perspective.

SCP-XXXX-A possesses a thin plastic layer partially covering the surface, aswell as many human and insect organic tissues of massive size floating at the surface or underwater, and a chlorine dispenser originally used as a safe base to monitor the surroundings.

There are 5 inhabitants in SCP-XXXX, labeled SCP-XXXX-1 through 5. These are 4 caucasian human individuals (2 male and 2 female) and a canine creature (from the Canis lupus familiaris race). These entities only appear during certain daytime hours in the summer season, and communication with these individuals at first was impossible and dangerous.

The wormhole's origin was later discovered by reaching the surface and achieving connection. The foundation sent a team towards the location and acquired the anomaly, as well as capturing the family to interview them about the item. The pool was brought into a containment cell and since then it has been studied its size-shifting properties.

Central Narrative:During the first encounter with the wormhole, the foundation sent multiple teams to enter SCP-XXXX. Once arriving to the other end, they were amazed at the ocean despite being empty and confusing. Other than that, no other anomalies were present until the appearance of SCP-XXXX-1 to 5, which were a threat to the team since the entities weren't aware of them, causing many casualties. After receiving information about the location of SCP-XXXX,it was successfully contained.

Hook-Attention-Grabber:This anomaly is simple, a wormhole that connects the ocean to a pool. However, the most interesting part is the many changes this SCP goes through the more understood it is, until completely containing it. If done correctly, it should be classified as a Euclid, then reclassified Keter, and finally Safe.

Additional Notes:This SCP has a lot of layers and changes. It may be a bit confusing due to everything it presents so i'll need to do it correctly. I'm fairly new here so I understand if there are problems with the idea, so please tell me since i want to improve on this concept.

item.title: Seeking Greenlights
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout: Standard SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: This SCP is a garden center of an abandoned hardware store. Containment is a faux construction site around the garden center. While external measurements only read 100 meters by 150 meters, measurements from the inside put it at 1.5 kilometers by 2 kilometers. The garden center is always full of plants, which change depending on the season. In spring, flowers are found throughout the center. In Summer vegetables are found In Fall, pumpkins and gourds are found. In Winter, Evergreen trees are found. Besides normal plants, unknown and anomalous varieties have been found. Inside the garden center, humanoid creatures roam the place. These creatures, while all distinctly human looking and having different physical features, all wear the employee uniform of the hardware store and will ask how they can help when approached. They are docile, but will attack an individual in self defense or if someone has damaged any of the plants inside.

Central Narrative: The main narrative is of exploration and interacting with the humanoids inside the SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: My concept is unique because it changes with the seasons. While somewhat similar to other SCP's with increased interior size and humanoids within, the space in my concept is finite, and the humanoids docile until attacked. Another unique part of my concept is the anomalous plants and unknown means of where the plants come from.

item.title: [Seeking Greenlight]: Objective Beauty
item.description: Proposal for SCP appearing to the beholder as the most beautiful thing possible, causing extreme obsession
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional

Page Layout (Optional): Plot development wil occur within various addenda

Elevator Pitch: Objective Beauty is a male humanoid, appearing to anyone who sees him as the most beautiful thing they have ever seen. Seeing Objective Beauty makes one forget all their former passions and interests and obsess about Objective Beauty. He himself is not malicious; he hates having this condition, he feels guilty when someone gets harmed because of him, and is very cooperative in general (class: very much safe)

Central Narrative: Objective Beauty is found having been ''kidnapped'' by his obsessed parents until the age of 17. Research begins on the nature of his changing appearance based on who sees him (one theory being his particles being in a complex superposition). Several researchers commit suicide after seing Objective Beauty; it is possible to wipe Objective Beauty out of one's memory, but this will leave them extremely nihilistic, as if they still know they had seen him and cannot remember him anymore. Several tests are completed with D-class suffering from mental illness and different types of animals, maybe even other SCP's. Objective Beauty grows more and more depressed when more tests offer the same outcome. often asking to be euthanized; this causes regular discussion within the Foundation ethics-commitee.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The deteriorating mental state of Objective Beauty, which worsens after each test resulting in either a death or an extremely potent memory wipe, leaving the memory wiped person as a shell of their former selves.

Additional Notes: The existence of Objective Beauty sparks a philosophical debate within certain departments of the Foundation, leaving a large number of personnel nihilistic, even though they have never seen Objective Beauty itself.

item.title: The Flooding Well (Looking for Greenlights)
item.description: A well that occasionally floods with a viscous slime, that may hold more than the eye can see...
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Page Layout: Normal description and containment procedures, but also plan on writing two expedition logs, a discovery log and an incident report.

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is a well located in a forest somewhere in south England, that on 60 to 80 hour intervals will fill up and flood with a slime (SCP-XXXX-1) that is extremely sticky and hard to control, except using methods of incineration. This slime will attempt to consume any biological matter it can find to grow itself. If SCP-XXXX-1's path is blocked for long enough, it'll go back down the well, reverting the effects of SCP-XXXX-A.

Central Narrative: The SCP is discovered after countless reports from trekkers in the area that they saw corpses with slime oozing out of every orifice in their body, and field agents are immediately dispatched to look around the area. Of course, only one of them returns safely, requesting backup, and soon after countless attempts at containment, incineration proves to work. This situation is less than favorable for the foundation, as SCP-XXXX's secrecy is easily breached, and they immediately attempt to block off the forest to everyone.

Hook / Attention Grabber: I want this article's real taste and horror to come from the Expedition logs, in which the inside of SCP-XXXX is explored, and countless new things about the true origin of the SCP come to light.

Additional Notes: I think that while the SCP's main idea may be a bit bland, that with a little bit of work and criticism, it could be refined, so constructive feedback is heavily requested and appreciated.

item.title: Knock Box (Seeking Greenlighting)
item.description: a black box that when a user hears said knocking they are tempted to open it
item.content:encoded:
The premise is pretty simple as it is a black box that when a user hears said knocking they are tempted to open it but they end up dead.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlighting: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mysterious

Page Layout: Standard Format

Elevator Pitch: Imagine if you take a walk in the forest silent and you see a random black box just sitting there you feel no attraction to it until you hear it knock twice, your suddenly now just have to look at that box you don't know why you have to always look at it but it just feels like you should. Again the box knocks and this time you go to the box standing right next to you glee with excitement and you open the box a holy light shines through like a video game chest and… you dropped to the ground, the box closes and you die of a heart attack.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: The black Box is a simple looking box or crate with a unknown brand stuck on the top it is a sticker on the left side of the box are other stickers saying "Every thing you would LOVE!" with pictures of a smiling family on it. The right side of the box reads "Are you having a rough time? containing in this very box you'll find the best things that will cheer you up!" although on the bottom of the box it reads in a black sticker "Silly you! this is the Bottom of the product!". After random increments of time the box begins knocking at the first 5 knocks the subject just simply examines the box, but after the 6th knock subject forcefully decide to open the box any attempts to stop said subject has always failed. subject that are going to open the box seem to not be affected by any sort of damage until said heart attack occurs. Subjects do indeed take physical damage but some how do not die until said heart attack. when subjects open the box or are about to there heart rate begins to rise and facial expressions begin to always show extreme excitement before open the box which there is a small chance that the pull out something out the box which at that point should be contained in a simple non see through bag. as soon as subject dies said box will close no matter what attempts of keep the box opened had failed. upon opening the box will show a bright yellowish light will glitter inside the box, the amount of objects in the box is unknown. objects inside the box seem to be quite simple man made objects of again unknown brand these objects include: pencils, blankets, coffee cups with coffee inside, toy cars, walkie-talkies, glass jars, gold bars, etc. each test of every subject pulls out a different object. it is presumed that the objects are what the subject wants or craves for.

Hook/Attention Grabber: The box is sure from its look it looks like a ordinary box but no matter the cause if someone hears that knock more than 6 times they always will get through what ever is in the way, (audio recording of the knock do not activate the reaction) the same effect happens with animals as well.

item.title: "The Gardener" [Seeking Greenlight]
item.description: A humanoid that must create less-than-obedient "drones" from plants and the unfortunate actions that follow.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Split across multiple iterations of the document spanning across 10 years as containment procedures and behavior of the SCP object change.

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is a humanoid who, by being near plant matter, accelerates their growth dramatically, and rather than bringing them into old age, makes matured plants into sentient "drones", dubbed SCP-XXXX-1, later -2 and -3, as the nature of the anomaly changes. While it begins as a child who turns plants into not terribly threatening sentient and hostile plants, later creations of SCP-XXXX display anomalous growths and sapience, making them more threatening. SCP-XXXX is not able to stop these events from happening, as it must be near living plants in order to live, and has no control of these creatures, often being prone to attack from them.

Central Narrative: SCP-XXXX is given its anomalous properties through the containment breach of a reality bender in a site near SCP-XXXX's home. A month after this breach, the Foundation investigates reports of deaths in a forest inhabited by SCP-XXXX, who had inadvertently converted several plants into SCP-XXXX-1 instances. An MTF unit is sent to find the source of these deaths, containing SCP-XXXX. Containment procedures begin simple, with only a modified humanoid containment chamber with a grass floor, as grass is found to be a non-issue when converted to SCP-XXXX-1. While SCP-XXXX grows over the span of a decade, containment procedures become more complex as it begins to generate SCP-XXXX-2 and -3 instances, eventually resulting either in the object's termination or a command to terminate it should it attempt to breach containment.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The main draw of the concept is SCP-XXXX-1+, and how their severity impacts the life and conditions of SCP-XXXX, who isn't really a catalyst for any events as much as its creations.

Additional Notes: My biggest concern is that sapient, hostile plant-monsters feels like a concept that's simply not threatening enough to warrant the drastic actions that I want the narrative to take. I've been toying around with different ideas on this matter, foremost being to make SCP-XXXX marginally stronger than a small group of people with sufficient plants nearby, and/or to slowly give SCP-XXXX plant-like qualities, causing its anomaly to take effect on itself, posing a security threat, but these are distateful to me both for fear of X-man syndrome, as well as the fact that the narrative simply isn't really that much about the humanoid. Any advice on this situation specifically would be greatly appreciated.
